name: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
description: Any establishment discharging trade effluent or sewage, or drawing/using water in a manner covered by Section 25

name: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
description: Any premises operating an 'air pollutant' emitting source (DG sets, boilers) above notified capacity thresholds

name: Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
description: Applies to every establishment; gives rise to the subordinate Rules (HWM, SWM, Plastic, Noise, E-Waste, Battery, BMW, C&D)

name: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
description: Any establishment generating, storing, or transporting hazardous waste (used oil, e-waste, batteries, chemical residues)

name: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016
description: Any establishment generating solid waste above the 'bulk generator' threshold (most hotels/hospitals qualify)

name: Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000
description: Applies to premises adjoining or within notified zones (commercial/industrial/silence)

name: Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016 (as amended 2022)
description: Brand owners/users of plastic packaging above notified thresholds (F&B outlets, amenities packaging)

name: E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022
description: Establishments disposing of end-of-life electronic/IT equipment as bulk consumers

name: Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022
description: Establishments using DG-set/UPS batteries above bulk-consumer threshold

name: Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016
description: Hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres and any healthcare facility generating bio-medical waste

name: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
description: Applies during renovation, refurbishment, or demolition activity generating C&D waste above threshold
